name: How long does the excavation phase typically take for a residential addition?

mainEntity.name: How long does the excavation phase typically take for a residential addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of the excavation phase for a residential addition varies depending on the scale and complexity of the project, including factors like soil type, required depth, and site access. We integrate this into the overall project timeline during our managed process. While smaller excavations might take a few days, larger additions requiring significant foundation work or utility trenching could extend to over a week, all coordinated to minimize disruption.
acceptedAnswer.description: Excavation duration for an addition depends on project scale and site conditions, typically ranging from a few days to over a week.
